answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to sustain a live bond that is hollowed out over time unless refreshed by unique, non-reusable attestations drawn from randomly selected peers across the network tundra. When a rare comet-triggered global audit arrives, every identity must present a fresh chain of those attestations; coordinated fakes collapse together because the attesters cannot be farmed at scale without already controlling established capital, and mismatched bonds are forfeited entirely.
